snippet.title: Servant of the Lake trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Begin your new job as a servant at the mysterious Vanderboom estate. Solve puzzles, serve the family and uncover their dark alchemical secrets in Servant of the Lake, a new upcoming single-player point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series.

Servant of the Lake by @RustyLake comes out August 2026!

Servant of the Lake in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/servant-of-the-lake/
Servant of the Lake on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636770/Servant_of_the_Lake/
Servant of the Lake on Itch: https://rustylake.itch.io/servant-of-the-lake
Servant of the Lake on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/servant-of-the-lake/id6748751735
Servant of the Lake on the Google Play store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.RustyLake.ServantOfTheLake

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/

#thinkygames #puzzlegame #exclusive #trailer #indiegames #pointandclick
